settings.direct: One claude agent (Sonnet 5, medium effort) in Do mode, no orchestrator, no Jev.
settings.harness: Full orchestrator on Auto routing with Jev intake: per-agent model routing, Architect / Builders / Critic as the depth requires, one Builder per run of sequential steps, parallel Builders in git worktree copies only for large independent steps.
settings.level: full-auto (tool approvals that still ask are auto-denied and recorded)
settings.fixture: Ledger Lite, a 6-module TypeScript project tested with node --test (scripts/bench/fixture).
